narrative.overview: A refined editorial CV: the calm confidence of a well-set academic paper rather than the noise of a developer-portfolio template. One narrow column (820px), generous section spacing, hairline rules doing the structural work, and a single deep-violet accent carrying every point of emphasis. Typography is the design: Fraunces display serif against Inter, with an oversized ghosted monogram as the only decorative flourish. The system rejects the generic AI-templated portfolio and the cluttered CV dump; restraint is the differentiator, but with full-contrast ink and committed hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with a single violet accent (Restrained strategy, accent ≤10%)
Serif display / sans body pairing; hierarchy by size and family, not color
1px hairline rules as the primary structural device
Dual themes (light paper / dark plum-black) with identical structure
Motion is subtle and functional: reveals, underline growth, small hover lifts

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only chromatic voice (status badges excepted: green = live, amber = in progress). A second accent hue anywhere else is a bug.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules, never heavy borders, resting shadows, or filled panels.

rules.name: The Serif-Means-Content Rule
rules.body: Fraunces marks things a human reads slowly (names, titles, the lede, the email). Inter carries everything scanned. Never set UI labels in the serif.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No element casts a shadow at rest. Shadow is feedback, not decoration.

dos: Do keep violet to small, high-signal moments (dates, indices, links, dots).
Do verify every foreground/background pair at WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 body) in both themes.
Do keep prose in ink-soft at ≥0.9375rem, line-height 1.65–1.85, max ~65–75ch.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for every new animation and keep reveal content visible-by-default when JS fails.
donts: Don't drift toward the generic AI-templated portfolio: no dark gradient heroes, no gradient text, no icon-card feature grids.
Don't produce a cluttered CV dump; every section keeps one clear skim path.
Don't add a second accent hue, colored side-stripes, or glassmorphism panels (the header blur is the single sanctioned translucency).
Don't set UI labels or metadata in Fraunces.
Don't add shadows at rest or borders heavier than 1px.
